final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT m.link_to_major AS c1, j.department AS c2, COUNT(*) AS c3 FROM member m JOIN major j ON j.major_id = m.link_to_major GROUP BY m.link_to_major, j.department), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(c3) AS t FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.c1, s1.c2, s1.c3, CAST(s1.c3 AS REAL) / s2.t AS c4 FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.t IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT c2, AVG(c4) AS a FROM s3 GROUP BY c2) SELECT s3.c1, s3.c2, s3.c3, s3.c4, s3.c4 - s4.a AS diff FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s3.c2 = s4.c2 WHERE s3.c4 > s4.a ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
